|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-5d6ra7-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-5d6ra7022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/5d6ra7.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/5d6ra7.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (V) (Errata)]]): '''First published 31 July 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/hires/5d6ra7.png</code> ([https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/594c3a0e5c180c7c2bde30343a173361cd7e6756 commit 594c3a0]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-5d6ra7ab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/5d6ra7.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/5d6ra7.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Power +1 while with your leader.
